description: Security-audit a target MCP server for prompt-injection / tool-poisoning. Fetches the server's advertised tools and statically analyzes each for hidden instructions, data-exfiltration hints, dangerous capabilities, cross-tool shadowing, and invisible-unicode payloads (OWASP LLM01/LLM08). Returns findings + a 0-100 risk score + verdict (clear/review/block). Cost: $0.005 USDC per scan via x402 (GET /scan/mcp HTTP variant is $0.05).

url.description: Target MCP server endpoint URL to audit

name: scan_mcp_server
